_source: Project instruction files come from the installed Spec Kit CLI: agent-context-defaults.json maps each integration key to its instruction file. Skills directories are the discovery paths the host itself searches: for OMP, the globs `.claude/skills/*/SKILL.md` and `.github/skills/*/SKILL.md` are read from the OMP binary's own skill discovery, and its user-level managed store is ~/.omp/agent/managed-skills; for Claude and Codex, the directories are the ones the installed Spec Kit integration registrar writes. A generated project skill is written into exactly one of the listed directories, never duplicated; the fallback for a host that lists none is .specify/pstack/skills/, which nothing discovers automatically. Regenerate this file when the installed Spec Kit version or the host's discovery changes, and never guess a path at runtime.

project_context.reason: project bootstrap needs a mapped instruction file in this project

browser.reason: local UI verification drives a real browser on this machine

terminal.reason: CLI and TUI verification drives a real terminal on this machine

forge.reason: PR status and merge come from gh or origin

scheduler.reason: a durable wakeup needs a scheduler the host actually provides

transcripts.reason: recall, eval, and trail checks read this workspace's session history

external_automation.reason: an external webhook automation needs a user-supplied endpoint and credential

omp.name: Oh My Pi
omp.skills_dir_evidence: OMP's own skill discovery reads `.claude/skills/*/SKILL.md` and `.github/skills/*/SKILL.md` from the project; its user-level managed store is ~/.omp/agent/managed-skills
omp.skills_dir_note: OMP registers extension commands under .omp/commands. A generated project skill goes in exactly one of these project globs, .claude/skills first unless the user names another, or in the user-level managed store; .specify/pstack/skills/ is only the fallback for a host that discovers no project skills at all.
omp.discovery_check: start a fresh session and confirm the skill is listed (OMP prints loaded skills on startup; `omp --skills=<glob>` narrows them). Do not report the skill as active before that.

capabilities.scheduler_reason: OMP has no durable scheduler; a long run is a supervised local process that stops with the machine
capabilities.transcripts_reason: verify access to this workspace's history through a live host tool or a supplied PSTACK_TRANSCRIPTS_DIR; the helper cannot inspect session tools
capabilities.external_automation_reason: no webhook automation service is wired in by default; supply an endpoint and a server-side credential, or skip that step
capabilities.browser_reason: OMP supports browser tools, but this helper cannot prove one is loaded or usable in the current session
capabilities.terminal_reason: OMP supports shell and PTY tools; inspect the live tools and prove the required interaction

claude.name: Claude Code
claude.skills_dir_evidence: the installed Spec Kit Claude integration registers commands and skills under .claude/skills
claude.skills_dir_note: Claude Code discovers project skills at .claude/skills/<name>/SKILL.md. Write a generated skill there and nowhere else; .specify/pstack/skills/ is only the fallback for a host that discovers no project skills.
claude.discovery_check: start a fresh session and confirm the skill appears in the skill list before calling it active.

capabilities.browser_reason: Claude Code ships no browser driver; drive one through a local harness such as Playwright or CDP, or an MCP browser tool
capabilities.scheduler_reason: Claude Code has no durable scheduler; a long run is a supervised local process
capabilities.transcripts_reason: Claude Code stores session transcripts outside the project; set PSTACK_TRANSCRIPTS_DIR to that directory for recall, eval, and trail checks
capabilities.external_automation_reason: no webhook automation service is wired in by default; supply an endpoint and a server-side credential, or skip that step
capabilities.terminal_reason: Claude Code supports shell tools; inspect the live tools and prove the required interaction

codex.skills_dir_note: Codex discovers project skills at .agents/skills/<name>/SKILL.md. Write a generated skill there and nowhere else; .specify/pstack/skills/ is only the fallback for a host that discovers no project skills.
